benchmark_tracking_success_rate.definition: Unmodified upstream tracking thresholds plus no failure termination

physical_obstacle_passage_rate.definition: From a central-platform start, clear the complete actual stair flight (+x for B2) or gap ring (any exit side for C2), land with all four feet beyond the far edge for 0.2 s and finish without failure; same episodes as original tracking metric
physical_obstacle_passage_rate.boundary_source: actual generated or cached per-tile mesh before placement
physical_obstacle_passage_rate.primary_denominator: all collected episodes; starts outside central platform cannot count as success
physical_obstacle_passage_rate.zero_width_gap: unmeasurable; null rather than automatic success

joint_tracking_and_passage_success_rate.definition: Intersection of upstream tracking success and physical passage for the same episode

source_unknowns: Author isaac-lab_2.3.2.sif image, digest, full pip freeze and driver are not published. Selected stack follows public Isaac Lab tag and is not proven binary-identical to that image.
Public results_seeded_1024 evaluated different checkpoint budgets than current task-specific Slurm defaults. Complete per-run env.yaml/agent.yaml and train CLI are not present.
C2 published model names indicate A2 initialization/refinement; the task Slurm script defaults to scratch. No undocumented refined settings are invented.
With RSL-RL 3.1.2 the source distribution safety patch may report unavailable and skip; its availability in the original author image is unknown.
Online USD/MDL asset contents are not vendored or independently fixed by the author; archive resolved assets on A40 for future repeatability.
A40 compatibility, Vulkan graphics availability, full-count VRAM capacity, smoke PPO and runtime effective config checks have not been executed.
Changing GPU, platform or PyTorch may change RNG sequences and trajectories despite identical numeric seeds; equal success rates are not guaranteed.
